brief:
Settlers set fires across occupied Palestinian territory in a night of coordinated arson attacks, Al Jazeera English reported. The incidents prompted renewed scrutiny of what Israeli officials and commentators have termed "Jewish terrorism" — violence by Israeli extremists against Palestinians.

The pogroms represent an escalation in settler violence that has persisted throughout the occupation of the West Bank. Palestinian communities have faced repeated attacks on homes, property, and agricultural land by Israeli settlers, often with minimal intervention from Israeli authorities.
dek: Israeli settler pogroms have continued in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli settlers torch Palestinian homes in West Bank rampage
